name: Chatra
description_en:
Chatra combines a website live-chat widget with asynchronous messenger mode, agent groups, rule-based bot scenarios, contact capture and messaging integrations. It can route a visitor to a team and preserve a conversation when agents are away. Its documented chatbot follows configured options and branches; the term intelligent bot does not establish a generative autonomous agent.

For an illustrative delivery question, show a targeted invitation, offer a configured answer or human handoff, collect contact details and route to support. Check invisible-agent behavior and whether replies sent outside Chatra appear in the widget. The assigned chatra.io site now leads to chatra.com. This profile reviews public documentation and a rendered price toggle; no account, widget conversation, API, subscription or export was executed.
description_zh:
Chatra结合网站实时聊天组件、异步留言模式、客服组、基于规则的机器人场景、联系资料采集及消息集成。它可将访客路由至团队，并在客服离开时继续会话。文档中的机器人按配置选项和分支运行，“智能机器人”名称不能证明生成式自主代理。

以假设配送问题为例，可展示定向邀请，提供配置答案或真人交接，收集联系方式并路由支持。应检查隐身客服行为，以及Chatra外发送的回复是否同步至组件。所分配chatra.io网站当前跳至chatra.com。本档案研究公开文档及渲染价格开关，未执行账户、组件会话、API、订阅或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: The widget switches to messenger mode when no agents are online; customer wording should set response expectations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 无客服在线时组件切换留言模式，应通过文案说明响应预期。

core_features.explanation_en: Build branching messages with explicit start triggers and a configured agent-transfer option.
core_features.explanation_zh: 构建分支消息，明确启动触发及转真人选项。

core_features.explanation_en: A required field does not make the whole form mandatory unless message gating is enabled.
core_features.explanation_zh: 字段必填不代表整表强制，需另启消息门槛。

core_features.explanation_en: Assign through embed settings,triggers,manual selection or visitor choice, subject to documented exceptions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可通过嵌入设置、触发、手动或访客选择分组，但有文档例外。

en: Pilot website delivery/product questions with a human support route.
Connect logged-in application users across devices using properly protected identity binding.
zh: 试点网站配送／产品问题并提供真人支持路线。
以正确保护的身份绑定连接跨设备登录应用用户。

API limits.en: REST calls use public and secret keys and JSON; documented limit60requests/min/account returns429withRetry-After. JS auxiliary user data is not authenticated identity.
API limits.zh: REST调用使用公私钥及JSON；文档限每账户每分钟60请求，超额429带Retry-After。JS辅助用户资料不等于已认证身份。

steps.en: Install one widget on a test page, invite agents and set realistic online/offline text.
steps.zh: 在测试页安装一个组件，邀请客服并设置真实在线／离线文案。

steps.en: Create one bot scenario with an initial message, every branch and an explicit human-transfer option; attach a trigger.
steps.zh: 创建一个含初始消息、每条分支及明确转真人选项的场景，再绑定触发。

steps.en: Test form gating,group selection,invisible status,external-email reply and cross-device identity before rollout.
steps.zh: 上线前测试表单门槛、选组、隐身、外部邮件回复及跨设备身份。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free为$0、1客服、每月5聊天。Essential月付每客服$31，年付展示月价$25；Pro分别$41／$33。付费月聊天不限。付费档试用10天无需卡。同时访客列表上限每付费客服席10人，不是网站访问上限。

faq.question_en: Does making email required force visitors to identify themselves?
faq.question_zh: 将邮箱设必填就强制访客提供身份吗？
faq.answer_en: Not by itself. The guide says the whole form can still be skipped unless the relevant message-gating option is enabled. With gating, agents receive no message or notification until completion.
faq.answer_zh: 仅此不够。指南称除非启用相应消息门槛，仍可跳过整表；门槛开启后，填完前客服不会收到消息或通知。

faq.question_en: Can an email address passed by JavaScript authenticate a customer?
faq.question_zh: JS传入邮箱可认证客户吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The API explicitly treats it as editable auxiliary information. Logged-in binding uses a unique secret clientId; authorization still needs careful implementation.
faq.answer_zh: 不能。API明确将其视为可修改辅助资料。登录用户绑定使用唯一保密clientId，仍需正确实现授权。

sections.title_en: Match the widget mode to actual staffing
sections.title_zh: 让组件模式匹配真实值守
sections.en:
Chatra provides live chat when agents are online and messenger mode when they are offline or invisible. Offline mode still accepts messages, but the normal guide says offline agents receive no notifications. Invisible agents normally avoid new chats while remaining available for invitations and existing work; an optional delayed-response notification changes that behavior. All agents becoming invisible sends the widget into messenger mode.

For an illustrative support shift, set wording that promises a later reply rather than immediate availability. Browser and mobile notifications also differ: mobile push is delayed thirty seconds when the same agent is logged in on both. Scheduled hours change status, but browser-only agents are not brought online until they open the dashboard; a mobile app can behave differently. Verify the real beginning/end of a shift, not just the published schedule.
sections.zh:
有客服在线时Chatra提供实时聊天，离线或隐身时提供留言模式。离线仍接收消息，但常规指南称离线客服无通知。隐身客服通常不接新聊天，但可被邀请及继续既有工作；可选延迟响应通知会改变行为。全体隐身会使组件进入留言模式。

以假设支持班次为例，应设置稍后回复文案，而非承诺即时在线。浏览器与移动通知也不同：同时登录时移动推送延迟30秒。排班会切状态，但仅浏览器使用者需打开面板才上线，移动应用可有不同表现。需验证真实班次开始／结束，而不只看排班设置。

sections.title_en: Test every branch and the separate form gate
sections.title_zh: 测试每条分支及独立表单门槛
sections.en:
The documented bot is a configured sequence of messages and selectable visitor replies. It requires an initial message, continuation for each choice and a targeted-chat trigger to start it. Leaving a bot message blank on a choice transfers that choice to agents. Without another reply option the scenario ends, optionally with a finishing message. This is distinct from a generative knowledge-answering agent.

The contact-form bot is another mechanism, appearing after a visitor sends a message and collecting up to five fields. Making a field required does not make the entire form compulsory: visitors can ignore it unless Get messages only once the form is filled or its offline equivalent is enabled. With that gate, agents get no message or notification before completion. Test abandoned forms, changed values, offline state and the human option on an unimportant page before applying the trigger broadly.
sections.zh:
文档机器人是配置消息及访客可选回复序列，需初始消息、每选项后续内容及定向聊天触发。某选项留空机器人消息可转客服，没有后续回复选项则结束，可附结束语。这与生成式知识问答代理不同。

联系表单机器人是另一机制，在访客发送消息后出现，最多收5字段。字段设必填不等于整表强制：除非启用填完才接消息或对应离线门槛，否则可忽略。门槛开启时，完成前客服无消息或通知。广泛应用触发前，应在非重要页面测试弃表、改值、离线及转真人。

sections.title_en: Routing and reply location affect continuity
sections.title_zh: 路由及回复位置影响连续性
sections.en:
Groups are a paid feature. A chat can be assigned by embed configuration, automatic trigger, manual change or visitor selection. Visitor selection requires at least two public groups and is suppressed when a group was already assigned or the visitor responds to an agent-targeted invitation. A Not sure choice routes to all online agents. Check group assignment on the actual page rather than assuming the selection menu always appears.

The guide says an agent reply claims a queued chat, while delayed responses can return it to the queue. For a visitor who has left, a Chatra reply can appear on return and reach their inbox if an email was supplied. Conversely, replies sent from an external email client or helpdesk do not update the widget conversation. That asymmetry can produce divergent records in a two-tool workflow. Test both directions and designate the authoritative reply path.
sections.zh:
客服组是付费功能，可由嵌入配置、自动触发、手动或访客选择分配。访客选择需至少两个公开组，已有分组或回复客服定向邀请时不会出现；Not sure则路由所有在线客服。应在真实页面检查分配，不能假设选组菜单总会显示。

指南称客服回复会领取队列聊天，延迟响应可使其返回队列。对已离开访客，Chatra回复可在返回时显示，若留邮箱还可送达收件箱。但通过外部邮件客户端或服务台回复不会更新组件会话，双工具流程可能因此记录分叉。应测试双向并指定权威回复路线。

sections.title_en: Treat identity binding as more than displaying an email
sections.title_zh: 身份绑定不只是显示邮箱
sections.en:
The JS API can pass names, email and custom data to the agent panel, but explicitly warns that users can modify these values. They are auxiliary context, not unambiguous identification. Cross-device account binding uses a unique secret random clientId stored for the logged-in user; the documentation warns that knowing it can grant access to the conversation. Public user IDs or email addresses are unsuitable for that value. Setting integration data replaces prior data; updateIntegrationData performs partial changes.

REST operations require public and secret API keys and JSON. The documented account-wide limit is sixty requests per minute;429 returns a Retry-After interval. Outgoing chatFragment events exclude automatic invitations and can be delayed by mandatory form gating. A finished-chat webhook follows conversation timing, not verified customer resolution. Use the receivedFrom field to identify externally originated messages and avoid two-way integration loops. No credential, identity or message operation was tested.
sections.zh:
JS API可向客服面板传姓名、邮箱及自定义资料，但明确提醒用户可修改这些值，仅属辅助上下文，不是无歧义身份。跨设备绑定用为登录用户存储的唯一保密随机clientId；文档警告知晓它可能访问对话，不宜使用公开用户ID或邮箱。set资料会替换原值，updateIntegrationData才是部分更新。

REST操作需公私API钥及JSON，每账户每分钟限60请求，429返回Retry-After间隔。chatFragment排除自动邀请，且可被强制表单门槛延迟。结束会话Webhook按会话时间规则触发，不代表问题已解决。可用receivedFrom识别外部来源消息，避免双向集成循环。此次未测试凭据、身份或消息操作。

sections.title_en: Separate reports and contact export from a restorable archive
sections.title_zh: 区分报表、联系资料导出及可恢复归档
sections.en:
The guide counts a conversation complete immediately when all agents leave, after five minutes if the visitor is offline or a new chat was unanswered, or after thirty minutes of inactivity with an online visitor. A later message is a new conversation. Response time measures the first visitor message to the first agent reply. These definitions matter before comparing volumes or interpreting a completed count as resolved customer work.

Reports can be downloaded as CSV; Emails export lets an operator choose fields/date range and optionally restrict to visitors who gave marketing consent. That is not proof of a full conversation/attachment backup or restoration. Public terms dated July2021 describe cancellation by email, possible account/content loss at termination and limited refund exceptions. Verify current retrieval and retention before cancellation, and retain the selected DPA/order rather than assuming contact export covers all records.
sections.zh:
指南将以下情况计会话完成：所有客服离开即刻；访客离线或新聊天未答后5分钟；访客在线但闲置30分钟。之后新消息算新会话。响应时间从访客首条消息至客服首答。比较数量或将完成数理解为已解决前，需要这些定义。

报表可下载CSV；Emails export可选字段／日期，并可只选同意营销的访客。这不证明完整对话／附件备份或恢复。2021年7月公开条款描述邮件取消、终止时可能失去账户／内容及有限退款例外。取消前须核对当前取回和留存，保留所选DPA／订单，不能假设联系资料导出覆盖全部记录。

sections.title_en: Use the current five-chat free limit and agent prices
sections.title_zh: 采用当前免费5聊天额度及客服价格
sections.en:
The current page lists Free at$0 for one agent and five chats/month. Both paid plans show unlimited monthly chats; that does not mean every integration or feature is included in both. A rendered billing-toggle check showed Essential$31 and Pro$41 per agent/month in monthly mode, versus$25/$33 in yearly mode. The paid-plan trial is ten days with no card. Annual checkout totals were not executed.

The real-time visitor list has a separate capacity of ten simultaneous displayed visitors per paid seat. It is not a cap on total site traffic or the same as monthly chat allowance. The terms describe location-selected currencies and taxes outside displayed prices; the observed dollar code corresponds to USD among those listed. Confirm feature entitlement, final currency, tax, renewal and export rights for the chosen order. Chatra’s service license is proprietary; an optional widget NPM package does not establish a self-hosted helpdesk.
sections.zh:
当前页面Free为$0、1客服及每月5聊天。两付费档月聊天不限，但不代表每项集成或功能都包含。渲染计费开关核对显示月付Essential／Pro每客服每月$31／$41，年付模式$25／$33，付费档试用10天无需卡，未执行年付结账。

实时访客列表另限每付费席同时显示10访客，不是网站总流量上限，也不同于月聊天额度。条款描述按地区选币，展示价格外另税，所观察美元在其列举币种中对应USD。应按订单确认功能、最终币种、税、续约及导出权利。Chatra服务许可专有，可选组件NPM包不建立自托管服务台。
